measurement.name: West Australian Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Reported offshore geographic breadth exceeds 1000 km in this synthesis. No representative width, finite upper end, statistical uncertainty, annual range or velocity-core boundaries extracted.
measurement.geographic_scope: Broad equatorward surface flow offshore of Leeuwin in the southeastern Indian Ocean; no reproducible cross-flow transect or paired endpoints supplied.
measurement.section_orientation: Offshore geographic breadth in government synthesis, not a defined transverse velocity section.
measurement.layer: Source describes equatorward surface current as shallow; no fixed numerical depth layer supplied for the breadth.
measurement.time_convention: Undated geographic synthesis published 2008; publication year and adjacent summer inflow discussion do not date or season the breadth statement.
measurement.boundary_rule: Issuer-reported greater-than geographic breadth. No velocity threshold, core edges, finite outer limit or section orientation extracted.
measurement.source_citation: Glenn, Nichol, Pattiaratchi, Daniell, Anderson, Borissova, Heap, Griffin and Fellows (2008), Vlaming Sub-Basin and Mentelle Basin: Environmental Summary, Geoscience Australia Record 2008/20, GeoCat 66577.
measurement.source_locator: Section 6.3.5, printed pp71-72 / PDF pp87-88, offshore WAC paragraph; Figure 6.15 printed p66 / PDF p82 is schematic; copyright printed pii / PDF p3.
measurement.extraction_method: Inequality transcribed from visually inspected original report prose. No contour digitization, current-axis diagnosis or conversion from the printed coordinate phrase.
measurement.source_quality_note: Government environmental synthesis, not a primary width-section analysis. The report cites Schott and McCreary (2001); identical named-current numeric wording was not found in inspected review text. Printed latitude 60 E mixes coordinate type and hemisphere notation.
remaining_gates: Recover the underlying velocity-based breadth definition and compatible layer/time support.
Resolve the printed coordinate-type conflict independently of the source inequality.
Review historical narrow-stream versus offshore-current naming without pooling dimensions.
Obtain repeated comparable sections before annual width ranges or map geometry.

historical_stream_context.source_access: Publisher-indexed abstract; original full article remains unreviewed.
historical_stream_context.scope: Narrow cyclonic stream with poleward coastal turn, distinct source convention from broad offshore equatorward flow.

original_regional_context.display_caption: West Australian Current: report describes offshore geographic breadth >1000 km. Not a measured 1000 km point, finite width interval, statistical bound or seasonal range.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Government synthesis, not a defined velocity section. The latitude 60 E coordinate phrase is inconsistent and is not converted to kilometres. Figure 6.15 is schematic; older 100-200 km cyclonic-stream width is separate naming context. No mapped band or seasonal playback inferred.

source_operator: Undated government synthesis of offshore geographic breadth; underlying velocity boundary method not recovered.
